Measure stability from precomputed vitals epochs

Source: R/integrations.R
stability_vitals.Rd

Converts long-form vitals samples into an item-by-epoch rating matrix and computes the same stability evidence as test_retest() without calling a model. Repeated epochs are treated as repeated measurements of the same item, never as independent calibration rows.

Usage

stability_vitals(
  task,
  id_col = "id",
  epoch_col = "epoch",
  score_col = "score",
  content_cols = NULL,
  label_levels = NULL,
  weights = c("unweighted", "linear", "quadratic", "ordinal"),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  n_boot = 1000,
  seed = NULL,
  audit_id = NULL
)

Arguments

task

A vitals::Task-like object with a get_samples() method, or a samples data frame.

id_col

Item identifier shared across epochs.

epoch_col

Epoch/run identifier.

score_col

Precomputed judge-score column.

content_cols

Every column visible to the judge (typically input, target, and result). Values must be invariant within item ID; otherwise epochs measure changing evaluation outcomes, not judge test-retest reliability. Identifier, epoch, and score columns are not content columns.

label_levels

Optional complete label universe. For unweighted runs left NULL with a factor score_col, the factor's non-blank levels are used as the label universe; a level no epoch used changes no unweighted coefficient (see agreement()). A numeric NaN score is a missing judgment, not a label. Weighted runs always require it: a factor's level order is not taken as evidence of the ordinal order.

weights

Agreement weights passed to Gwet's coefficient.

conf_level

Bootstrap confidence level.

n_boot

Number of item-bootstrap resamples.

seed

Optional bootstrap seed.

audit_id

Optional evidence-bundle identifier shared with calibration.

Value

A yourhonor_stability object with source = "vitals" provenance.

Examples

# Three epochs of six items, in long form as vitals stores them; the
# judge-visible `input` is the same in every epoch.
samples <- tibble::tibble(
  id = rep(paste0("q", 1:6), each = 3),
  epoch = rep(1:3, times = 6),
  input = rep(paste("question", 1:6), each = 3),
  score = c("C", "C", "C", "P", "P", "C", "I", "I", "I",
            "C", "C", "C", "P", "P", "P", "I", "P", "I")
)
stability_vitals(samples, content_cols = "input",
                 label_levels = c("I", "P", "C"), n_boot = 200, seed = 1)
#> 
#> ── yourhonor test-retest stability ──
#> 
#> 3 runs - pairwise disagreement 0.22 [0.00, 0.61].
#> gwet_ac1: 0.67 [0.34, 1.00].
#> Any-flip rate at exactly 3 runs: 0.33; missing judgments: 0.00.
